title: Area 6 Lockheed Martin aerial operations facility

tellings.quote: Area six, which is by the Yaka Mountain Flat, which has a Loheed Martin owned aerial operations facility

plain: A part of the Nevada test lands called Area 6, near Yucca Flat, holds an aerial operations facility owned by the defence company Lockheed Martin, according to an online researcher who goes by UAPGerb. He says so on an episode about how the Pentagon's UFO programme works, without naming his source, pointing to it as one of the places where secret flight work could be done.
